sources.notes: Founder-run matcha cart in Dearborn and Dearborn Heights: weekend pop-ups, restaurant nights, private events and catering. Rotating dessert-flavor matchas (tiramisu, strawberry shortcake, coconut vanilla, banana pudding, cereal milk, honey whip, ube). Prices and payment not listed. Site listed Oct 24-25 2026 (Dearborn Heights) as the latest; no Nov-Jan dates found. Dates also on Instagram @whatatastematcha. Evidence: https://bigwissmatcha.com/
